shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.edit: This is an edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: It is a big dog. / It is a small dog. / The bike is new. / The bike is used.
assets.prompt: IN A PARK, on one lawn, from left to right: a BIG shaggy dog standing on all four legs; a SMALL puppy-sized dog standing on all four legs; a shiny NEW bicycle with spotless bright red paint on its kickstand; a SECOND bicycle that is OLD and USED, with faded scratched blue paint, a rusty chain and a torn seat, on its kickstand. There are exactly TWO dogs and exactly TWO bicycles; the two bikes are clearly different, one new and one old. No people. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines; the same ground and background run continuously behind every subject, and the subjects stand at slightly different distances from the camera like in a real scene. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere.
